findings.title: Deployment rollout is paused
findings.cause: Deployment web is paused, so it does not roll out: 0 of its 2 replicas run the current pod template and 0 are ready

evidence.what: Deployment has spec.paused: true, 0 of 2 replicas updated, 0 ready
evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-deployment-paused -o jsonpath='{.spec.paused}{" "}{.status}'

findings.fix: Resume it when the change is ready: kubectl rollout resume deployment/web -n kd-deployment-paused.
